m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard, you're back! You're ready to take that Storm Jewel from Caleban? Let's go get it! Beans, you guard the Ark.
Darn it, James, I'm a doctor, not a security guard!
And these castaways all appear to be in perfect health. So what else have you got to do? Come on, Wizard - let's go!
Greetings!
They've found us, Wizard! Look out!
No, wait - I'm a friend! Look, Wizard - there's an Elevator up there that lowers to this spot.
I'll only get in your way in a fight - when you reach the top, use the Elevator to bring me up to you. Now go blow that Horn!
This is it, Wizard! Engage!
So, we have guests. You think you fooled me with your Horn? HA! My Raider friends warned me you were coming.
They say you want my Jewel. You will never take it! Lower the Bridge!
Now you are doomed, little Wizard, and your Pig friend too! Smash them!
Those huts, Wizard - the vines that control the bridge come from them! Let's get in there and raise the Bridge!
Looks like we're halfway there, Wizard! Let's find the other... uhhh... plant winchy thing.
You've done it, Wizard!
It's a long way up, but we can make it if we work together! Let's go!
We made it! Now let's get young Wezlee up here.
Thanks for the lift! The shipwreck is Caleban's lair -you should be able to find him on the upper deck.
Let's get to it! After you, Wizard. Wezlee, you wait out here where it's safe.
If you say so...
Noooo!
Son! What are you doing?
There is a better way, father.
Sycorax, the evil witch, tricked the Beastmen into believing this Jewel controlled their minds long before I was born. The Beastmen lived as her slaves.
You were her favorite, Father, but when you found the one called Khan, you turned against her. Khan rid the island of her once and for all.
But after Sycorax fell, what did you do? You took the Jewel and turned it on the Beastmen again - now the tribes were your slaves!
I used the Jewel to keep us strong! We must stand as one against the outsiders! But the Jewel... its power is a lie?
Let it go, Father. We have let fear and hate rule us for too long. We will work with the outsiders, and live in peace.
Wizard, take this Jewel far away from here.
Caleban trick us! He must die!
No! He will be exiled, just as he exiled my mother and I. Maybe he will bury his hate in the Jungle.
Well done, Wezlee. You Beastmen can overcome your savage past, and build a better destiny. The Jewel will... hold on...
Wait - this isn't a Storm Jewel - it's just worthless quartz! But why did Khan say...
Khan lied to us! He wanted us to come up here... and leave the Ark unguarded! We have to go, before it's too late!
James! We're in trouble!
Beans! What happened?
Caleban live on Beast Mountain. Beastmen have fort at bottom, then long path lead up to his House on top. Many guards.
Luckily Caleban's followers aren't too bright. Even if you don't look like you belong, they'll mistake you for a Raider if you blow the Horn.
Caleban's Jewel will be your biggest problem. Wait, it's a fake? That's great! That will make things much easier.
You have a friend back in Nowhere that can help us? Good - go get him. I'll meet you at the foot of the Mountain.
Way up the mountain is hard. Many guard posts - you must fight them all! Take good care of Wezlee.
You want to get Caleban's Jewel? Go to Beast Mountain - fight way through fort and then up to top!
